newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait, AGIP sign Italy refinery, downstream deal.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait, AGIP sign Italy refinery, downstream deal.

text.p: A Kuwait Petroleum Corp subsidiary and Italy's Agip SpA signed a deal for joint operation at Agip's 300,000 barrels per day Milazzo refinery, the official Kuwait News Agency reported late on Monday.
KPC officials were unable to confirm that the deal had been finalised. Kuwaiti officials said in June that the deal would be signed very soon.
KUNA said KPC had also acquired 330 Agip service stations in Italy in addition to taking a 50 percent stake in the refinery in Sicily.
KUNA quoted a KPC official as saying that the deal still required the approval of Italy's anti-monopoly authority.
He said that under the deal the refinery would be upgraded to produce "environmentally friendly" products.
